addController(address).details: ensure controllerAddress is a verified controller implementation address

params.controllerAddress: The address of controller implementation contract deployed

returns._0: Id of the controller added to the controllers-mapping in socketGateway storage

addRoute(address).details: ensure routeAddress is a verified bridge or middleware implementation address

params.routeAddress: The address of bridge or middleware implementation contract deployed

returns._0: Id of the route added to the routes-mapping in socketGateway storage

params.controllerId: The Id of controller-implementation in the controllers mapping

params.routeId: The Id of route-implementation in the routes mapping

executeController((uint32,bytes)).details: ensure the data in request to be built using the function-selector defined as a         constant in the controller implementation contract

params.socketControllerRequest: socketControllerRequest with controllerId to identify the                                   controllerAddress and byteData constructed using functionSelector                                   of the function being invoked

returns._0: bytes data received from the call delegated to controller

executeControllers((uint32,bytes)[]).details: ensure the data in each controller-request to be built using the function-selector defined as a         constant in the controller implementation contract

params.controllerRequests: a list of socketControllerRequest                              Each controllerRequest contains controllerId to identify the controllerAddress and                              byteData constructed using functionSelector of the function being invoked

executeRoute(uint32,bytes).details: ensure the data in routeData to be built using the function-selector defined as a         constant in the route implementation contract

params.routeData: functionSelectorData generated using the function-selector defined in the route Implementation

executeRoutes(uint32[],bytes[]).details: ensure the data in each dataItem to be built using the function-selector defined as a         constant in the route implementation contract

params.dataItems: a list of functionSelectorData generated using the function-selector defined in the route Implementation

params.controllerId: controllerId is the key in the mapping for controllers

params.routeId: routeId is the key in the mapping for routes

rescueEther(address,uint256).details: as this is a restricted to socketGatewayOwner, ensure the userAddress is a known address

params.userAddress: address to which native-balance is to be rescued

rescueFunds(address,address,uint256).details: as this is a restricted to socketGatewayOwner, ensure the userAddress is a known address

params.amount: amount of ERC20 tokens being rescued
params.token: address of the ERC20 token being rescued
params.userAddress: address to which ERC20 is to be rescued

swapAndMultiBridge((uint32,bytes,uint32[.details: ensure the swap-data and bridge-data is generated using the function-selector defined as a constant in the implementation address

NewRouteAdded(uint32,address).notice: Event emitted when a router is added to socketgateway

OwnershipTransferRequested(address,addre.notice: Event emitted when ownership transfer is requested by socket-gateway-owner

BRIDGE_AFTER_SWAP_SELECTOR().notice: FunctionSelector used to delegatecall from swap to the function of bridge router implementation

addController(address).notice: Add controller to the socketGateway This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

addRoute(address).notice: Add route to the socketGateway This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

controllerCount().notice: storage variable to keep track of total number of controllers registered in socketgateway

controllers(uint32).notice: storage mapping for controller implemenation addresses

disableController(uint32).notice: disable controller by setting ZeroAddress to the entry in controllers-mapping identified by controllerId as key. This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

disableRoute(uint32).notice: disable a route by setting ZeroAddress to the entry in routes-mapping identified by routeId as key. This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

executeController((uint32,bytes)).notice: execute a controller function identified using the controllerId in the requestThe caller must first approve this contract to spend amount of ERC20-Token being bridged/swapped

executeControllers((uint32,bytes)[]).notice: sequentially executes all controller requestsThe caller must first approve this contract to spend amount of ERC20-Token being bridged/swapped

executeRoute(uint32,bytes).notice: executes functions in the routes identified using routeId and functionSelectorDataThe caller must first approve this contract to spend amount of ERC20-Token being bridged/swapped

executeRoutes(uint32[],bytes[]).notice: sequentially executes functions in the routes identified using routeId and functionSelectorDataThe caller must first approve this contract to spend amount of ERC20-Token being bridged/swapped

getController(uint32).notice: Get controllerImplementation address mapped to the controllerId

getRoute(uint32).notice: Get routeImplementation address mapped to the routeId

rescueEther(address,uint256).notice: Rescues the native balance to an address this is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

rescueFunds(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescues the ERC20 token to an address this is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

routes(uint32).notice: storage mapping for route implementation addresses

routesCount().notice: storage variable to keep track of total number of routes registered in socketgateway

setApprovalForRouters(address[],address[.notice: Give Infinite or 0 approval to bridgeRoute for the tokenAddress This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

swapAndMultiBridge((uint32,bytes,uint32[.notice: swaps a token on sourceChain and split it across multiple bridge-recipientsThe caller must first approve this contract to spend amount of ERC20-Token being swapped
